{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
print(f'Completed orders: {completed_mask.sum()}')

# Filter data: completed orders, excluding QA orders
filtered_data = data[completed_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue: {channel_revenue.to_dict()}')

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()
print(f'Max channel: {max_channel}, Max revenue: {max_revenue}')"}
